_comment: Audit D-04 — the trust strip. Show ONLY what Allied can prove. Anything left empty renders nothing rather than a placeholder. Open questions Q2 (which clients may be named) and Q3 (which licences, safety program, insurance and bonding may be stated publicly) are answered by filling the arrays below — no component changes needed.

clients._q2: Confirm written permission before adding a client here. Logos go in `logo` once supplied; until then the name alone is shown.

experience._note: January 2025 RFPQ states 25+ years in business; no exact founding date is documented. The displayed figure is 25 + (current year - 2025).

credentials._q3: Add only credentials Allied actually holds and can evidence: Technical Safety BC licence number, gas and refrigeration certifications, WorkSafeBC coverage, COR (if held), liability insurance limit, bonding capacity. Each entry needs `label` and may carry `detail`.

partners._note: Equipment brands Allied installs. Greyscale logos, alt text = brand name (A-07).
